name: mcp-toolkit
description: Typed MCP tool calls: a codegen CLI over an MCP server's tools/list, a framework-free runtime and React hooks

scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @miragon/mcp-toolkit-tool-codegen run test:coverage && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @miragon/mcp-toolkit-tool-codegen-core run test:coverage && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @miragon/mcp-toolkit-tool-codegen-react run test:coverage
scripts.test:mutation: pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @miragon/mcp-toolkit-tool-codegen run test:mutation && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter @miragon/mcp-toolkit-tool-codegen-core run test:mutation
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs scripts --max-warnings 0 && pnpm -r run lint
scripts.lint:fix: eslint eslint.config.mjs scripts --fix && pnpm -r run lint:fix
